name: Missionary Work
overview: Missionary work is a divine mandate to proclaim God's glory and wonders to all nations, as seen in Psalms 96:3 and the Great Commission in Matthew 28:19. Believers are called to go into all the world, preaching the gospel and making disciples, empowered by the Holy Spirit to be effective witnesses (Mark 16:15; Acts 1:8). This mission requires dedication to prayer and the ministry of the Word (Acts 6:4), recognizing that faith comes through hearing the message from faithful preachers (Romans 10:14).
